description: This file defines functions and constants for sanitizing and normalizing JSON Schema objects to ensure compatibility with the Gemini validation system, including handling unsupported keywords, flattening union types, resolving references, and removing invalid schema constructs.

methods.name: copySchemaMeta
methods.description: Copies metadata keys ('description', 'title', 'default') from one schema object to another.

methods.name: tryFlattenLiteralAnyOf
methods.description: Attempts to flatten an array of schema variants into a single type and enum if all are literals of the same type.

methods.name: isNullSchema
methods.description: Checks if a schema represents a null value.

methods.name: stripNullVariants
methods.description: Removes null schemas from a list of schema variants.

methods.name: extendSchemaDefs
methods.description: Extends schema definitions with local $defs or legacy definitions.

methods.name: decodeJsonPointerSegment
methods.description: Decodes a JSON Pointer segment by replacing escape sequences.

methods.name: tryResolveLocalRef
methods.description: Resolves a local JSON Schema reference to its definition.

methods.name: simplifyUnionVariants
methods.description: Simplifies union schema variants by flattening literals or merging single variants.

methods.name: cleanSchemaForGeminiWithDefs
methods.description: Recursively cleans a schema object, removing unsupported keywords, resolving references, and flattening unions for Gemini compatibility.

methods.name: flattenUnionFallback
methods.description: Fallback flattening for union schemas to produce a schema accepted by Google's validation.

methods.name: cleanSchemaForGemini
methods.description: Main exported function that initiates schema cleaning process.
